# ScanForge — Full LLM Index

> Extended index of every public page on ScanForge with a one-paragraph summary.
> Use this alongside /llms.txt for the platform-level overview.
> Base URL: https://qrandbarcodegenerator.vercel.app
> All pages are free, no signup, no watermark. Static generation runs in the browser.

## Top-level routes

- [Homepage](https://qrandbarcodegenerator.vercel.app/) — Free QR code and barcode generator. Two workspaces (QR + barcode), custom designer, bulk generator, dashboard. Comprehensive FAQ, how-to and comparison sections.
- [QR Code Generator](https://qrandbarcodegenerator.vercel.app/qr) — 12 QR content types with a custom designer (dot patterns, gradients, logo upload). Live scan-reliability validation. PNG, SVG, PDF export.
- [Barcode Generator](https://qrandbarcodegenerator.vercel.app/barcode) — 15 barcode formats across retail, general-purpose, industrial and 2D matrix. Live format validation with automatic GS1 check-digit computation. PNG, SVG, PDF export.
- [Bulk Generator](https://qrandbarcodegenerator.vercel.app/bulk) — Paste a list or import a CSV and generate hundreds of QR or barcode codes at once. ZIP of PNGs or single label-sheet PDF. 100% in-browser processing.
- [Learn](https://qrandbarcodegenerator.vercel.app/learn) — Short practical guides on creating QR codes, adding logos, generating barcodes, printing and bulk generation.
- [About](https://qrandbarcodegenerator.vercel.app/about) — ScanForge is a free, browser-first QR code and barcode generator. No signup, no watermark, no daily limits.

## Barcode formats (15)

- Retail: EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E
- General-purpose: Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, Codabar, Interleaved 2 of 5, MSI
- Industrial & shipping: ITF-14, GS1-128
- 2D matrix: Data Matrix, PDF417, Aztec

## Key facts

- Price: Free forever. No premium plans, no credits, no forced watermark.
- Signup required: Never for generation. Optional, only for saving codes.
- Processing: Static QR & barcode generation runs client-side in the browser.
- Exports: PNG, SVG, PDF, ZIP (bulk).
- Static vs dynamic QR: ScanForge generates static QR codes only — the destination is encoded directly in the image, no redirect server, no expiry, no account needed.
- GS1 / GTIN: Generating a barcode image does NOT register an official GS1 identifier. Users must only encode identifiers they are authorised to use. The platform computes and verifies the check digit; official GTIN registration is handled by GS1.
- Privacy: For static generation, data is not uploaded. Uploaded logos and CSV files stay on the user's device. Only codes explicitly saved to an account are stored server-side.
